summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the Receipts upgrade (attachments + Paid-from) as client@axiom.ai on Skyward Sparks. All 10 acceptance criteria PASSED: login → /receipts, New Receipt modal opens with all fields, payment-account dropdown populated (11 eligible bank/CC/cash accounts from CoA), category dropdown populated (17 expense accounts), file input accepts PNG → thumbnail + filename + size render with removable X, save issues 'Receipt saved' toast, list row shows correct Merchant, Amount ($42.50), Paid-from ('1000 Cash and Bank'), and clickable Paperclip 'View' link opening the data URL. Receipt without attachment/payment renders '—' in both Receipt and Paid-from columns with no crash. >8 MB upload is blocked with the exact toast 'Attachment too large. Max 8 MB.' Trash-can delete (with confirm dialog) removes the row from the list. Test receipts were cleaned up.

issues: Minor: React hydration warning in console — '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered by the Emergent instrumentation wrapper (x-source spans) inside <option> in the Paid-from and Category selects. Not a functional bug, no user-visible impact, but adds console noise. If the instrumentation is app-side, consider suppressing wrapping inside <option>.

critical_code_review_comments: Receipts.jsx (109): 8MB check uses raw file.size but the resulting base64 data URL is ~33% larger; the request body could still exceed backend/proxy limits (typically 10MB). Consider warning near 6MB or validating after base64 encode.
Receipts.jsx (22): delete uses window.confirm() — inconsistent with the app's shadcn dialog style used elsewhere.
Receipts.jsx: no loading state for initial list fetch (load()); empty state shows 'No receipts.' briefly on cold load which can be misleading.

paySource filter (98-103) is somewhat over-broad — includes A/R, Inventory, Prepaid Expenses, A/P, Sales Tax Payable in the 'Paid from' list (visible in test: 11 options included 1200 A/R, 1300 Inventory, 1500 Prepaid, 2000 A/P, 2200 Sales Tax Payable). Users may pick a non-payment account by mistake. Tighten to true bank/cash/credit-card subtypes only.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 2 test receipts (Walmart Test $42.50 w/ attachment + payment_account, NoAttachNoPay $5.55 w/o either) during the test. State restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working end-to-end. Only cosmetic/code-review notes remain: (1) base64 size vs raw size check, (2) confirm() dialog, (3) 'Paid from' account filter too permissive. Console shows a hydration warning about <span> inside <option> from the x-source instrumentation — safe to ignore for functional review.
